title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：sponsor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sponsor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the coach ① found the sponsor that no player in the field would have noted, and he said the finding was the whole of the season. The ② sponsor, meaning the backer itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a sponsor, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sponsor in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ sponsor at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sponsor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the coach said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sponsor was the whole of the matter, meaning the support and not the backer. The ⑥ sponsor, meaning the support and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; sponsor, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a backer and a support. He said the support is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ sponsor had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ sponsor of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of noting; sponsor, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sponsor I remember is the backer noted in the record, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ sponsor, my mother said in 1983, is the only backer that improves by being noted; every sponsor, she said, is a support that has agreed to look like a backer. She said the support was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 赞助人；发起者（指球场里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 赞助人；发起者（指那位赞助人本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the sponsor 找这一位赞助人
D. n. 赞助人；发起者（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 赞助人之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的赞助人之事）
F. n. 赞助人；发起者（指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 赞助人、后援（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 后援（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the sponsor that no player in the field would have noted
The sponsor, meaning the backer itself and not the whistle
the sponsor at the far stand
the sponsor was the whole of the matter

The sponsor of the whole thing
A sponsor, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: find the sponsor 意为“找这一位赞助人”，1974 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯记下的一位赞助人做了一遍。
sponsor 意为“赞助人；发起者”，指那位赞助人本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记下。
sponsor 意为“赞助人；发起者”，指球场里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
sponsor 意为“赞助人；发起者”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sponsor 意为“赞助人、后援”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位后援就是那件事的全部。
sponsor 意为“后援”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位赞助人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sponsor 意为“赞助人；发起者”，指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1979 年这一位成了赛事记录里的一行。
sponsor 意为“赞助人之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的赞助人之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记下。
sponsor 意为“赞助人；发起者”，我记得的是赛事记录里记下过的那一位，1981 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一位。
sponsor 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，赞助人是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的赞助人。
